unresolved.reason: No current Afghanistan or HKSAR primary source establishes a usable ordinary HKSAR-passport short-visitor route and actual issuance timing. Operational and security material is not a visitor-status rule.

No current Bangladeshi or HKSAR primary source directly establishes ordinary HKSAR-passport visitor eligibility and whether the visa is issued electronically, before travel, or on arrival. Portal availability is not used.

The live HKSAR dataset names the British Virgin Islands but supplies only a one-month duration, not whether access is visa-free or visa-on-arrival. No current BVI authority supplies the missing ordinary HKSAR-passport result.

The live HKSAR dataset names Burkina Faso but supplies only a 14-day duration, not the applicable issuance route. No current Burkina Faso authority directly establishes ordinary HKSAR-passport eligibility and issuance timing.

No current Central African or HKSAR primary source directly establishes an ordinary HKSAR-passport visitor route and actual issuance timing. No residual rule is inferred from the absence of a dataset row.

No current Chadian or HKSAR primary source provides a direct ordinary HKSAR-passport eligibility result and actual visitor-visa issuance timing. An online service alone is not treated as eVisa evidence.

No current PRC or HKSAR authority maps an ordinary HKSAR Passport to a normal Mainland China short-visitor baseline without substituting a Home Return Permit, PRC passport, transit, or other document.

No current Republic of the Congo or HKSAR primary source directly establishes an ordinary HKSAR-passport visitor route and actual issuance timing. No residual rule is inferred from the absence of a dataset row.

Côte d'Ivoire's general online pre-enrolment material does not directly establish ordinary HKSAR-passport eligibility or distinguish electronic issuance from airport issuance. It is not inferred as an eVisa.

The live HKSAR dataset names Djibouti but supplies only a 14-day duration, not the applicable issuance route. No current Djiboutian authority directly resolves ordinary HKSAR-passport eligibility and timing.
The live HKSAR dataset names Egypt but supplies only a 90-day duration, not whether the HKSAR passport route is visa-free or arrival-issued. No current Egyptian authority resolves that timing.

No current Guatemalan or HKSAR primary source directly establishes ordinary HKSAR-passport visitor eligibility and actual issuance timing. No treatment is transferred from PRC, other British documents, or list omission.
No current Guinean or HKSAR primary source directly establishes ordinary HKSAR-passport visitor eligibility and actual issuance timing. A generic online process is not a nationality result.

No current Guinea-Bissau or HKSAR primary source directly establishes ordinary HKSAR-passport visitor eligibility and actual issuance timing. No residual rule is inferred from a portal or list omission.
No current Honduran or HKSAR primary source establishes an ordinary HKSAR-passport visitor baseline without residence, third-country visa, or special-document conditions.

The live HKSAR dataset names Iran but supplies only a 21-day duration, not whether access is visa-free or arrival-issued. No current Iranian authority directly resolves ordinary HKSAR-passport treatment and issuance timing.
No current Iraqi or HKSAR primary source establishes an ordinary HKSAR-passport tourist result and actual issuance timing. PRC passport, regional, portal, and conditional routes are not substituted.
No current Liberian or HKSAR primary source directly establishes ordinary HKSAR-passport visitor eligibility and whether any approval is a visa issued before travel or airport processing.

No current Macao or Hong Kong authority maps an ordinary HKSAR Passport to a normal Macao visitor baseline without substituting resident identity cards, Visit Permits, transit treatment, or other documents.
The live HKSAR dataset names Mali but says duration is determined by competent authorities on arrival; it does not establish an ordinary HKSAR-passport visa-free or visa-on-arrival baseline.
No current Marshall Islands or HKSAR primary source establishes an ordinary HKSAR-passport visitor route. Compact, United States-linked, and admission-specific arrangements are not transferred.

The live HKSAR dataset names Niger but supplies only a 14-day duration, not the applicable issuance route. No current Nigerien authority directly resolves ordinary HKSAR-passport eligibility and timing.

No current DPRK or HKSAR primary source establishes a usable ordinary HKSAR-passport short-visitor route and actual issuance timing. Operational closure and permission controls are not taxonomy states.
The live HKSAR dataset names North Macedonia but supplies only a 90-day duration, not whether access is visa-free or arrival-issued. No reproducible current official checker result resolves it.
No current Pakistani or HKSAR primary source directly establishes ordinary HKSAR-passport tourist eligibility and actual visa issuance. Application service availability is not eligibility evidence.

No current official source maps entry authorisation or a travel-document status directly to an ordinary HKSAR-passport Palestinian Territory baseline. Crossing and permit controls are not flattened into ETA.
No current São Tomé and Príncipe or HKSAR primary source establishes ordinary HKSAR-passport visitor eligibility and actual issuance timing. Conditional third-country-document routes are excluded.

No current Sudanese or HKSAR primary source directly establishes ordinary HKSAR-passport visitor eligibility and actual issuance timing. No residual rule is inferred from absence of a dataset row.
